description: The plot illustrates the loss over a number of iterations for six different model configurations: Vanilla, StrmLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=64, H), SepLLM (n=64, H/T), and SepLLM (n=128). The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0 to 140,000, with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 20,000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" and uses a linear scale ranging from 2.4 to 3.4, with tick marks spaced at regular intervals of 0.1. All lines in the plot are solid, lack markers, feature a faint shaded band indicating variance, begin above the maximum y-axis value of 3.4 near iteration 0, and exhibit a sharp initial decline followed by a gradual, steady decrease across the remainder of the x-axis. Specifically, the purple line representing "Vanilla" decreases to approximately 2.46 by the end of the x-axis. The blue line representing "StrmLLM (n=64)" decreases to approximately 2.62. The orange line representing "SepLLM (n=64)" decreases to approximately 2.53. The green line representing "SepLLM (n=64, H)" decreases to approximately 2.52. The red line representing "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" decreases to approximately 2.49. Finally, the dark purple line representing "SepLLM (n=128)" decreases to approximately 2.51 by the end of the iterations.
